_comment: Shareable DC example (AresONE + OCS + Arista + one topology). Edit every 192.0.2.* IP and the passwords, keep topology device_ip in sync, then DATA → Import. Field checklist: docs/getting-started/DC8_PICKUP.md. Do not share a full appliance backup or a live-lab export.

topology.name: DC Lab Topology
